{"slug": "ai-website-builder-for-beginners", "title": "AI Website Builder for Beginners: How Kodely Works", "metaTitle": "AI Website Builder for Beginners — Kodely", "metaDescription": "No templates, no jargon, no card required. Describe your site in plain English, watch it build live, and publish free. See how Kodely works for total beginners.", "targetKeyword": "ai website builder for beginners", "category": "Feature", "bodyHtml": "

Why beginners get stuck with normal website builders

You open a website builder, pick a template, and then... nothing happens on its own. You're staring at placeholder text that says \"Your Headline Here,\" a stock photo of people laughing at a laptop, and forty settings panels you don't understand. Do you need a \"container\" or a \"section\"? What's the difference between a \"block\" and a \"widget\"? Most builders assume you already know how websites are put together. If you don't, every choice feels like it could break something.

That's decision paralysis, and it's the single biggest reason people give up before they ever publish a site. Kodely skips it entirely. You don't pick a template or learn a page-builder's vocabulary. You just describe what you want, in your own words, and watch it get built in front of you.

The 3-step Kodely flow

Kodely works the same way for a complete beginner as it does for a developer — it just doesn't require you to know any code.

  1. Describe. Tell Kodely what you're building in a chat box, the way you'd explain it to a friend: a landing page for your dog-walking business with a booking form and a photo gallery. No design jargon required.
  2. Preview. Kodely writes a real, working website behind the scenes — actual code, not a mockup — and shows you a live preview as it's built. You see the real thing, not a sketch of what it might look like later.
  3. Publish. When you're happy with it, click Publish. Your site goes live on its own public web address instantly, at no extra cost.

Want to change something after that? Just say so in chat — make the button bigger, or change the headline to something punchier — and Kodely edits the real files behind your site to match.

What makes it actually beginner-friendly

A lot of tools call themselves beginner-friendly and then hand you a blank canvas anyway. Here's what's actually true about Kodely:

  • No credit card to start. You get 750 free credits the moment you sign up, no card required, so you can try building a real site before you decide whether to pay for anything.
  • Fixes happen in plain English. If something looks wrong, you don't dig through settings — you just describe the problem in chat and Kodely fixes it.
  • Mistakes are free to undo. Every successful step of building your site is saved as a checkpoint. If a change makes things worse, rolling back to an earlier version costs nothing.
  • You're not charged for failures. If a generation doesn't compile correctly, Kodely tries to repair it automatically first, and you're never charged for a build that didn't work.
  • Publishing is simply included. Your site goes live on a free yourname.kodely.site address the moment you publish — not a trial, not a limited-time offer. It's just part of using Kodely.

An honest note on what Kodely can't do yet

We'd rather tell you upfront than have you find out later. Right now, Kodely builds the front end of your site — the pages, layout, text, and design people actually see. A few things aren't there yet:

  • No backend, database, or logins. Kodely doesn't currently generate things like user accounts, payment processing, or a database behind your site.
  • No custom domains yet. Published sites live at a yourname.kodely.site address; connecting your own domain, like yourbusiness.com, isn't available yet.
  • No zip download. You can view and copy your site's actual source code inside Kodely any time — it's real code, and it's yours to look at and reuse — but there's no one-click zip export yet.
  • Editing happens through chat. There's no drag-and-drop or click-to-edit canvas today; every change is made by describing it.

If you're building a simple site — a portfolio, a small business page, a landing page, an event site — none of that gets in your way. If you need logins or a database on day one, Kodely isn't the right fit yet.

Pricing in plain terms

Kodely runs on credits, which pay for the actual AI work of building your site. There's no subscription and no hidden agency tier — just a free starting balance and top-ups when you need more.

PlanCreditsPrice
Free signup750 credits$0, no card required

Credits never expire, and a build that fails to compile is never charged. See the full breakdown on the pricing page.

FAQ

Do I need to know how to code?

No. You describe your site in plain English and Kodely writes the code for you. You can look at that code any time you're curious, but you never have to touch it.

Is the free tier really free?

Yes. You get 750 credits when you sign up, no credit card needed, and you can use them to build and publish a real site.

What kind of code does Kodely actually generate?

A real Vite plus React plus TypeScript plus Tailwind CSS app, built from real component files — not a static mockup and not raw HTML glued together.

Can I use my own domain name?

Not yet. Right now every published site lives at a free yourname.kodely.site address.

What happens if I don't like a change I made?

Roll back to any earlier checkpoint for free. Every successful build is saved automatically, so you can always undo.

How is Kodely different from other AI site builders?

See our detailed comparison in Kodely vs Lovable.

Ready to see it for yourself? Start building free — no credit card required. Curious about costs first? Check out pricing.
